title: Successive list drop
statement: Let $x$ and $r$ be Boolean lists, let $p$ be a natural number, and let $b$ be a Boolean. If dropping the first $p$ entries of $x$ gives the list whose first entry is $b$ and whose remaining list is $r$, then dropping the first $p+1$ entries of $x$ gives $r$.
hypotheses_covered: The list obtained by dropping p entries from x is b followed by r
